items.title: Switch project, open any element and navigate from the command palette (⌘K)

And I am Alex
When I press Ctrl+K, type "task-003" and press Enter
Then the element panel of "task-003-logout" opens

acceptance_criteria.title: Switch project from the palette
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture and the custom fixture added

And I am Alex

acceptance_criteria.title: Navigate to a screen

acceptance_criteria.title: Say when nothing matches

acceptance_criteria.title: Close the palette with Escape

items.title: The recent Memory activity on Today with a link to the Timeline
items.story: As Casey, I want the recent Memory activity on Today with a link to the Timeline, so that I see what moved since I last looked

acceptance_criteria.title: Show the last 5 Memory events
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture open
And I am Casey
When I open Today
Then the "Recent activity" card lists 5 events, newest first
And each state-change event shows the time, the element, the transition "from → to" and the author, and each creation event shows "created" instead of a transition
And the card ends with the link "Open the Timeline"

acceptance_criteria.title: Add an event made outside the UI
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture open
And I am Casey
When Morgan approves "task-001-login-form" with the CLI in a terminal
Then within 5 seconds the first event of "Recent activity" is "task-001-login-form pending → approved · Morgan"

acceptance_criteria.title: Leave out commits that are not Memory events
steps: Given the console is running with the kanban fixture open
And I am Casey
Given the last commit of the fixture is "docs: fix a typo in README"
When I open Today
Then "Recent activity" does not list "docs: fix a typo in README"

items.title: Read a decision-log as a rendered document in the element panel, with its history
items.story: As Casey, I want to read a decision-log as a rendered document in the element panel, with its history, so that I understand the decision before taking it

acceptance_criteria.title: Read a decision-log as a rendered document
steps: Given the console is running with the custom fixture open
Given I am Casey
And the body of "dl-002-use-fastify" has the sections "Context", "Options" and "Decision"
When I open the element panel of "dl-002-use-fastify"
Then the panel renders the body as Markdown with the headings "Context", "Options" and "Decision"
And the history lists "submitted by Casey" with its commit

acceptance_criteria.title: Open the decision-log from Documentation links
steps: Given the console is running with the custom fixture open
Given I am Casey
And "docs/01_vision/00_index.md" links to the file of "dl-002-use-fastify"
When I select that link
Then the element panel of "dl-002-use-fastify" opens with its rendered body

acceptance_criteria.title: Read a decision-log with an empty body
steps: Given the console is running with the custom fixture open
Given I am Casey
And "dl-003-empty" is a `draft` decision-log whose body is empty
When I open the element panel of "dl-003-empty"

items.title: Approve or reject a decision-log in-discussion from its panel
items.story: As Casey, holding `approver`, I want to approve or reject a decision-log `in-discussion` from its panel, so that I take product decisions without a developer

acceptance_criteria.title: Approve a decision-log as a product owner holding approver
steps: Given the console is running with the custom fixture open
Given the DNA gives Casey the roles product-owner, approver
And I am Casey
When I approve "dl-002-use-fastify" from its panel with the reason "Agreed in the planning meeting"
Then the fixture's last commit is "wf(decision-log): approve dl-002-use-fastify [in-discussion → ready]"

acceptance_criteria.title: Send a decision-log back to draft
steps: Given the console is running with the custom fixture open
Given the DNA gives Casey the roles product-owner, approver
And I am Casey
When I reject "dl-002-use-fastify" from its panel with the reason "Needs a cost estimate"
Then the fixture's last commit is "wf(decision-log): reject dl-002-use-fastify [in-discussion → draft]"
And Requires you of Casey lists "dl-002-use-fastify" with "Rejected by Casey: Needs a cost estimate"

acceptance_criteria.title: Keep the decision informational for a product owner without approver
steps: Given the console is running with the custom fixture open
Given the DNA gives Casey the roles product-owner
And I am Casey
When I open the element panel of "dl-002-use-fastify"
Then the footer shows "Reserved to approver — Morgan, Alex can act"

items.title: `ui.yaml`: the UI's only file
items.description: `.wingfoil/ui.yaml` holds the UI's conventions (`version`, `taxonomy`, `progress`, `artifacts`) and nothing else — no permissions (they are WingFoil's, L6), no secrets. It has a JSON schema in `contracts/`. Without it, or when it fails the schema, the UI uses inferred defaults and warns. A preset (Kanban, Scrum, `sw-life-cycle`) is offered only when the file does not exist, refused when it maps a type the project does not declare, and validated before writing. `progress.scope` declares a type only; the current element is derived.
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] Each shipped preset validates against the schema and matches its fixture; the schema rejects a `permissions` key; every scenario listed passes.

items.title: Progress scope and computations
items.description: Completion and iterated figures cover the current element of the `progress.scope` type: with WingFoil 0.3 the one `workflow status` reports; before it, the most advanced element not in its first or last non-archived state (ties: lowest version); none → whole project. Reference completion = done linked elements / linked elements; project completion = unweighted mean over references with ≥ 1 linked element (Q8); coverage = elements carrying all `requires` categories / elements whose type has `requires`, project-wide. Open bugs and pending gates are project-wide; a state both gate and `waiting:` is not a pending gate.
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] On the custom fixture with the `sw-life-cycle` preset the UI shows exactly: scope `minor-v0.1`, project completion 25 %, tasks 1/4, open bugs 1, pending gates 3, coverage 3/5 — and pending gates 2 after `bug-001-toast-overlap` is approved to `triaged`.

items.title: Ingestion only when the CLI sets every required field
items.description: An ingestion is offered only when every required field of its type can be set by the CLI version in use (0.2.2: `title` and id/path tokens through `memory add --set`); its steps run as the workflow's own verbs. Otherwise it is read-only with the missing field named.
items.fit_criterion: [boolean] On 0.2.2 the custom fixture offers exactly `decision-log-ingest`, and the kanban fixture (whose ingest workflows declare no action) offers none; every listed scenario passes.
